scientific_integrity: Proof uses exact rank-one expansions and finite-dimensional spectral invariants. Standalone symbolic and exact-rational verification is supplemental. No independent mathematical audit, external certification or formal priority claim.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one use of each of three independently fixed positive symmetric pairwise convex contacts on a four-vertex star; no theorem about other topologies, repeated sweeps, freely optimized contact parameters, or non-Euclidean losses. Literature comparisons identify no direct covering theorem in inspected materials but do not certify worldwide novelty.
title: Opposite optimal orderings for three-edge weighted gossip
